what_was_attempted: Estimate how many hours Eliud Kipchoge would take to cover the Moon’s minimum perigee distance at his marathon world-record pace, rounded to the nearest 1,000 hours.
approach_taken: The agent searched for information about the Moon and Kipchoge, fetched the Moon page to obtain the minimum perigee distance, and then calculated the travel time from the marathon record pace. It committed a numerical answer without changing strategy.
